arabic text: HUSSAIN (A.S.) WALE HAI ZINDA, HUSSAIN TERE LIYE
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF HUSSAIN (A.S) ARE ALIVE\nJUST FOR YOU HUSSAIN (A.S)
THEY HAVE BEEN SENT BY BATOOL (S.A)

arabic text: DUAEN RATON KO KARTE THE ISLIYE HAIDER\nYEH RAZ KARBOBALA ME AYAAN HUA SAB PAR
english translation text: HAIDER (A.S) WOULD PRAY AT NIGHT FOR THIS\nTHE SECRET WAS UNVEILED TO EVERYONE IN KERBALA

arabic text: ALI NE MAANGA THA BETA HUSSAIN TERE LIYE
english translation text: ALI (A.S) HAD ASKED FOR A SON, JUST FOR YOU HUSSAIN

arabic text: ALI TO AAYE THE QIBLA USSE BANANE KO\nSIYAAH POSHI BATATI HAI YEH ZAMANE KO
english translation text: ALI HAD COME TO MAKE IT A QIBLA\nTHE BLACK CLOTH ON IT TELLS THE ENTIRE WORLD…
IN ACTUAL FACT, THE KA’ABAH WAS MADE

arabic text: TERE BAGAIR NAHI LAGTA DIL PAYAMBAR KA\nBATA RAHA HAI HUM KO ZUHOOR AKBAR (A.S.) KA
english translation text: WITHOUT YOU, THE PROPHET’S HEART IS NOT AT EASE\nTHE BIRTH OF ALI AKBAR TELLS US THAT
THE PROPHET HAS COME BACK AGAIN

arabic text: UTHENGE TAAZIE WADA HAI SAR RAHE NA RAHE\nGHAME HUSSAIN (A.S.) RAHE GA PISAR RAHE NA RAHE
english translation text: WE WILL CONTINUE THIS AZADARI, WHETHER OUR HEADS REMAIN OR NOT\nTHE LAMENTATION ON HUSSAIN (A.S) WILL CONTINUE, WHETHER OUR SONS REMAIN OR NOT

arabic text: HAR EK SHAHEED KE LAB PE YAHI TARANA HAI\nQAZA TO TUJHSE MULAKAT KA BAHANA HAI
english translation text: ALL MARTYRS HAVE THE SAME SLOGAN ON THEIR LIPS\nDEATH IS JUST AN EXCUSE TO MEET WITH YOU

arabic text: MAI BAAR BAAR MARUNGA\nHUSSAIN TERE LIYE
english translation text: I AM READY TO DIE OVER AND OVER\nJUST FOR YOU HUSSAIN (A.S)…
